description: Fetch the most recent CPSC consumer product recalls, newest-first, from a window of the last N days (default 30, up to 365). Use for "what's been recalled lately?" or a product safety feed; to find recalls by product, brand, hazard, or an older date range, use cpsc_search_recalls. A page holds up to 1,000 recalls. Continue by adding the number returned to offset. Narrowing days drops the oldest recalls because the window is anchored to today. Pass a recall_number to cpsc_get_recall for the full record. CPSC jurisdiction: consumer products, including child-resistant packaging for drugs and supplements, ATVs and snowmobiles, bicycle tires, and gun safes and locks; food and drugs (FDA), on-road vehicles and their tires (NHTSA), boats (USCG), pesticides (EPA), and firearms (ATF) belong to other agencies.

days.description: Look back this many days from today. Defaults to 30. Use 7 for a weekly digest, 90 for a quarterly review.

limit.description: Maximum recalls to return. Defaults to 20. A page holds at most 1000 recalls. A larger limit is clamped to 1000, with a notice when more recalls remain.

offset.description: Skip this many recalls in the window before returning results. To page through total_found, raise offset by the number of recalls the previous page returned. An offset at or past total_found returns an empty result set rather than an error.

name: cpsc_get_recent

cpsc_jurisdiction.description: Which products CPSC covers, including those near the lines of other agencies, and which agencies own food and drugs (FDA), on-road vehicles and their tires (NHTSA), boats (USCG), pesticides (EPA), and firearms (ATF).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_error`: The CPSC recall service (saferproducts.gov) was unavailable, timed out, reported a temporary failure reading its recall data, or sent an unreadable response. `upstream_rejected`: CPSC rejected the request instead of returning recalls, and it rejects the same request every time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when recalls remain past this window — call again with offset raised by the number of recalls returned.

notice.description: Present when the page needs explaining: a window with no recalls (with a larger days to try), an offset past the last recall, or a page capped at 1000 recalls under a larger limit with more recalls remaining (with the offset to continue from).

offset.description: Number of recalls skipped before this window.

start.description: Start date of the query window, ISO 8601.

data_quality_notes.description: Gaps this server observed in the CPSC record — absent hazard text, absent product entries. Derived from which fields CPSC left empty, not from any judgement about the recall itself. Empty when nothing is missing.

items.description: One gap found in the CPSC record.

recall_number.description: Recall identifier. Pass to cpsc_get_recall for full detail.

remedy_options.description: CPSC remedy types: Refund, Repair, Replace, New Instructions, Dispose, Label, No Remedy Available, Inspect. CPSC may leave the list empty or report an unclassified value. Open cpsc_get_recall for remedy instructions when the list is empty.

source_note.description: Provenance caveat: recall fields are CPSC record text with HTML markup and character codes converted to plain text, not otherwise edited or verified; check cpsc_url before a consumer-facing decision.

total_found.description: Total recalls in this period, counted before offset and limit are applied.

truncated.description: True when recalls in the window remain past this page — always equal to has_more.

title: Get Recent CPSC Recalls
